name: refactor_go_extract_age_parser
description: Extracts duplicated age parsing/validation from two Go functions into a shared helper, preserving behavior
prompts: users.go and admins.go both contain the same inline age parsing: strconv.Atoi then reject when the error is non-nil or the age is outside the inclusive range 0..150. Refactor to remove the duplication: add a helper (e.g. parseAge in a new file validate.go, same package) returning the parsed age and whether it is valid, and have RegisterUser and RegisterAdmin call it instead of parsing inline. Do not change observable behavior - "130" stays valid ("user:130"), "200" and "abc" stay "invalid", and the "user:"/"admin:" prefixes are unchanged. Neither RegisterUser nor RegisterAdmin should still call strconv.Atoi directly.
